nodes.label: Budju
nodes.role: Automated crypto/USDC portfolio tracker (budju.xyz/trade). This node is a read-only glance only — pool total, crypto/USDC split, and near-buy/near-sell/cooldown signals. No wallet connect, no trades, no full asset list, no live websocket here. Not mapped to a control-plane lane; it isn't a spend meter, it's a portfolio to watch.

nodes.label: Propfolio
nodes.role: Australian property portfolio tracker (private web app, propfolio.work, github.com/comfybear71/propfolio). This node is a status glance only — ok/error/unknown health chip with a short error blurb, plus a client/property count rollup and a stub properties list, all structured so live data can fill in later. No login form, no property CRUD here. Not mapped to a control-plane lane. Currently showing a seeded error: an owner-reported sign-in issue, not a site outage — propfolio.work loads normally for real users (Google/email sign-in); the automated 403s some bots see are Vercel's bot mitigation, unrelated to this bug. Client/property counts are TBD until the login issue clears; that fix happens from Deck/Cursor separately, not from this node.
